subject: Ellum Pilot — model shortlist, context lift, and hourly token budget
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@ellumhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ellum Pilot — model shortlist, context lift, and hourly token budget

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time this week. Attached is a first-pass XLSX with hourly token budgets and per-call token estimates based on the sample you shared in the kickoff. The goal of this thread is to lock the model shortlist and the context assumptions so we can schedule a load test and produce a provisional cost estimate.

Quick summary and ask:
- Candidate models we recommend evaluating in pilot: Redwood-RL-13B (16k window, higher-quality summarization), Redstone-7B-int8 (8k window, cost-efficient NLU), and OpenLlama-2-13B-quant (fallback for long context when throughput/latency matters).
- Embeddings: we suggest using EmbedLite-2 for similarity retrieval (lower cost) but can run EmbedPro for higher recall during the pilot.
- Context scenarios: 
  * Short (1–2 prior turns + prompt): ~1.5–3k tokens
  * Medium (5–8 turns + patient summary): ~3–8k tokens
  * Long (complete notes + history): 8–16k tokens (rare, but critical for some flows)
- Peak load assumptions in the sheet are conservative — please confirm: requests/hour and typical token-per-response.

Ask: could you confirm the following for the sample flows you sent?
1) Typical prompt length (tokens) and average response tokens
2) What proportion of calls will need long-history context vs short context (rough split)%
3) Any SLA/latency requirements for interactive flows (e.g., <300ms, <800ms p95)

I attached: ellum_pilot_token_estimates.xlsx (token budget by route).

Once you confirm the items above we’ll: (a) lock a shortlist for the load test, (b) pick quantization and batching settings, and (c) provide a pilot-level estimate and MAP for sign-off.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@ellumhealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ellum Pilot — model shortlist, context lift, and hourly token budget

Thanks, Aisha — useful start. Answers inline below and I attached a small sample payload (ellum_sample_payload.json) so you can see our real payloads.

1) Typical prompt length: ~140 tokens (median), with responses averaging ~320 tokens for the summarization flows.
2) Context split (rough): short 60%, medium 30%, long 10% (long is the full patient visit history + notes; occurs for complex case triage).
3) Latency requirement: interactive UI flows should target <700ms p95; background summarization can be looser (2–4s).

Traffic notes: current pilot target ~1,200 requests/hour with planned ramp to 5k r/hr if initial tests go well. Concurrent users may spike to 60 active sessions during clinic hours.

A couple of asks from our side: can you show an example cost delta between Redstone-7B-int8 and Redwood-RL-13B for our medium context workload? Also we will need the load test schedule to align with our engineering team next week.

—Sara Klein
Product Manager, Ellum Health
sara.klein@ellumhealth.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Klein <sara.klein@ellumhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ellum Pilot — model shortlist, context lift, and hourly token budget

Hi Sara / Aisha —

Great details — thanks Sara. A few recommendations from the CS/implementation side before we lock the shortlist:

1) Context windows: given that long-context calls are ~10% but are functionally critical, we suggest configuring routing rules so that long-history requests are sent to a 16k-capable instance (Redwood-RL-13B with dynamic KV cache). Medium and short can default to Redstone-7B-int8 to save cost.

2) Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for the UI flows — many calls include repeated patient metadata. We expect a 12–20% token reduction after warm cache.

3) Quantization + batching: start pilot with int8 for Redstone-7B and int4/8 experiments for Redwood-RL-13B. We will tune batch sizes during the load test; target p95 latency under 700ms for short/medium.

4) Load test plan: propose Wed 16 Jul, 10:00–13:00 PT. That gives our infra time to provision reserved instances for the pilot and run baseline runs before the canary. I attached a short test plan (ellum_load_test_plan.md) — please confirm team availability.

5) Acceptance criteria for pilot: p95 latency <800ms for interactive flows; <10% error rate; and cost per 1k tokens within the agreed pilot budget in the XLSX.

I'll own the load test and ramp control. Vivek and Ben — I flagged you in case you want to weigh in on capacity or contract questions.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

Sara / team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Below is the consolidated mutual action plan (MAP) I’ll upload to HubSpot and link in the SOW/Docusign flow:

Mutual Action Plan — Ellum Pilot (v1)
- Confirmed shortlist: Redstone-7B-int8 (default), Redwood-RL-13B (long-context and summarization), EmbedLite-2 for retrieval.
- Context routing rules: short/medium -> 7B; long -> 13B (16k).
- Load test: Wed 16 Jul 10:00–13:00 PT (Grace to run).
- Acceptance criteria: interactive p95 <800ms, error rate <10%, token budget within pilot sheet.
- Deliverables from Ellum: sample payload (attached), engineering contact for test window, SOW signature.
- Deliverables from Redwood: provisioning of pilot capacity, test harness, final pilot cost estimate, MAP PDF for sign-off.

Attachments: ellum_map_v1.pdf (MAP & timelines), ellum_pilot_token_estimates.xlsx (token/cost draft).

Next steps:
1) Sara — confirm Wed 16 Jul test window works for your eng team (please reply with contact & Slack handle).
2) I’ll follow up with a short cost delta table between 7B-int8 and 13B for your medium workload by EOD Monday.
3) Grace will provision the test and share the exact endpoint and credentials 24 hours prior.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
DocuSign SOW: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&token=abc123

Thanks all —
Aisha
